messages:
Carla M: Heads up — planning a gradient deploy for autocomplete-service TOMORROW 09:00 PST. Proposal: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% over ~3h. Need a deploy owner and a smoke lead.
Ben R: I can own the deploy, available 08:30-12:30 PST. Will run the rollout and watch app metrics.
Alice H: I can own smoke checks and output quality on the 5% slice. Quick checklist: smoke perf, sample responses, embedding sanity. I will post short notes after each bump.
Priya S: Which user cohorts for slices? I suggest mobile-NA first (1%), then web-EU (5%), then combined low-traffic APAC (warmup).
Nikhil P: +1 to that ordering. For 1% maybe route a tiny APAC warmup if infra allows.
Ben R: Draft schedule: staging deploy 08:30 PST -> prod 09:00 deploy to 1% -> 09:10 validate -> 09:30 bump to 5% -> 10:15 bump to 20% -> 11:00 bump to 60% -> 12:00 finish 100%. Can compress if all green.
Carla M: Good. Add automatic rollback triggers: CPU > 2x baseline OR 5xx > 1% of requests for 5m. Also require manual approval if semantic regressions spotted.
DevOps Bot: deploy scheduled by Ben R at 3500012345. Rollback triggers set: cpu_multiplier > 2.0, error_rate > 0.01. Notifying channels: #eng-sre, #eng-releases.
SRE Oncall: I will monitor infra dashboards and be ready to execute rollback. Please ping me with the rollout dashboard link when live.
Alice H: Short smoke steps I'll run after each bump:
```
1) Hit /health on all nodes (expect healthy)
2) Run 50 sample prompts from smoke set and compare tokens
3) Check p95 latency < 250ms and tail < 500ms
4) Validate 10 embedding pairs, cos_sim > 0.82
5) Quick sample QA for hallucination/regression
```
Ben R: Sounds good. I won't bump until Alice posts a thumbs-up.
Priya S: One ask: do not toggle quantization flags in this deploy — keep inference config identical to previous stable release.
Nikhil P: Also add request header `x-gradient-canary: true` for lineage and tracing in logs.
Carla M: Agree. Ben, plan staging run at 08:30, quick smoke, then prod 09:00. If staging fails, abort prod and escalate.
Ben R: staging 08:30 -> prod 09:00. I'll paste rollout dashboard and trace links here when available.
Alice H: I'll post smoke results ~5-7m after each bump and call out any anomalies. :thumbsup:
SRE Oncall: If >3 infra alerts fire in a 5m window, I'll trigger rollback and notify execs.
Carla M: Great. If anything changes overnight (cohort availability, infra), update this thread. Thanks everyone.
